events.text: Apple reports fiscal fourth-quarter results; call 5:00 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Per Apple’s investor relations page: results about 4:30 p.m. ET, call 2:00 p.m. Pacific. First earnings call with John Ternus as CEO.

events.text: October ISM Manufacturing PMI, 10:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and time per ISM's release calendar; September's reading was 54.5%, the ninth straight month of expansion.

events.text: Palantir reports third-quarter results after the close; webcast 5:00 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and webcast time per Palantir's Oct. 12 Business Wire announcement.

events.text: Pfizer reports third-quarter results; webcast 10:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and time per Pfizer's investor relations event page.

events.text: AMD reports third-quarter results after the close; call 5:00 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and call time (2 p.m. Pacific) per AMD's Oct. 6 GlobeNewswire release.

events.text: Uber reports third-quarter results; call 8:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Call time (5:00 a.m. Pacific) per Uber's Oct. 5 Business Wire announcement.

events.text: Qualcomm reports fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year results after the close; call 4:45 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and call time (1:45 p.m. Pacific) per Qualcomm's Oct. 22 PR Newswire release.

events.text: October ISM Services PMI, 10:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and time per ISM's 2026 release calendar; September's reading was 54.9%, per ISM.

events.text: Bank of England interest rate decision, minutes, and November Monetary Policy Report (noon London time).
events.detail: Per the Bank of England's 2026 MPC calendar. Bank Rate is 3.75%; in September the committee voted 6-3 to hold, with three members favoring a quarter-point increase.

events.text: October Employment Situation (jobs report), 8:30 a.m. ET.
October Consumer Price Index (CPI), 8:30 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and time per the BLS CPI release schedule.

events.text: SEC deadline to approve, reject, or open proceedings on Nasdaq ISE's proposed listing rules for options on spot crypto ETFs (SR-ISE-2026-42).
events.detail: Date designated in an SEC Federal Register notice (Release 34-106448). The SEC can act earlier or extend review by opening proceedings.

events.text: Nvidia reports fiscal third-quarter results; conference call that afternoon.
events.detail: Date per Nvidia's Aug. 26 earnings call, where the company said the third-quarter call is scheduled for Nov. 17.

events.text: Disney reports fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year results before the open; webcast 8:30 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and webcast time per Disney's Oct. 12 Business Wire announcement.

events.text: Supreme Court hears the challenge to third-country deportations (date to be set).
events.detail: Deportations can continue in the meantime; a decision is expected by summer 2027.
Congress must pass funding or another stopgap by then to avoid a partial government shutdown.
